verdict.rationale: Proa documents declaring signals in interactive islands, compiling them to a small vanilla-JS module with seed state on a shared ~1.3 KB runtime. That establishes first-party reactive state, but nothing confirms that only the dependent UI code re-runs when a signal changes. Missing for 10: documentation of fine-grained dependency tracking and selective re-execution, details of the signal API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
